instruction: Provide alternatives or variants of the name Noah.

metadata.explanation: Task variation asking user to show names similar to 'Noah' on babycenter.com. Uses regex pattern matching to verify navigation to the Noah name detail page. This avoids hardcoding specific URL IDs which may not be verifiable. The evaluator checks if the URL contains the pattern 'babycenter.com/baby-names/details/noah-' which is the standard format for name detail pages on this site.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing Chrome getter (get_active_url_from_accessTree) and existing metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match). No new functions needed. Pattern matches the babycenter.com URL structure for name detail pages.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree using standard Chrome address bar selectors
Metric correctly performs regex pattern matching on the URL using is_expected_url_pattern_match
Expected regex pattern 'https://www\.babycenter\.com/baby-names/details/noah-' appropriately matches Noah name detail page URLs
Data flow is correct: getter extracts URL → metric checks pattern → returns 1.0 for match
Incomplete semantic coverage: instruction asks to 'show similar names' but evaluator only verifies navigation to Noah's page, not whether similar names are actually displayed
Acceptable trade-off: verifying URL as proxy for task completion is reasonable given OSWorld environment limitations for dynamic content verification
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding HTML content verification to check if similar names section is actually present on the page (e.g., checking for specific CSS classes or elements that contain similar name lists)
Could add a secondary check using get_active_tab_info to parse page content and verify similar names are rendered
